title: Shooter Development
description: Become a complete shooter: flawless mechanics, quick preparation, catch-and-shoot range, off-screen shooting, and elite shot selection.
audience: Wings and guards who want to become elite shooters

steps.title: Level 1 — Build the Shot
steps.description: Lock in repeatable shooting mechanics — the foundation every advanced shooting skill depends on.

steps.title: Level 2 — Catch and Shoot
steps.description: Master the catch-and-shoot: footwork, quick release, and shooting off the pass in rhythm.

steps.title: Level 3 — Extend Your Range
steps.description: Push your range to the three-point line while keeping the same mechanics and preparation.

steps.title: Level 4 — Shoot on the Move
steps.description: Learn to shoot coming off screens — curls, flares, and pin-downs — with balance and speed.

steps.title: Level 5 — Choose Your Shots
steps.description: Develop shooter IQ: understand which shots help your team and which ones hurt it.
